quotes.author: Amy Lee

quotes.quote: Would not the child's heart break in despair when the first cold storm of the world sweeps over it, if the warm sunlight of love from the eyes of mother and father did not shine upon him like the soft reflection of divine light and love?
quotes.author: Max Muller

quotes.quote: I am a bit of a hopeless romantic. I really do have a faith and a belief in love, and when I love, I love hard.
quotes.author: Melanie Fiona

quotes.quote: The Lord has been there from wanting to be a momma, to having a wonderful childhood life and dreaming of having a good motherhood as a child; always wanting to meet a good old country boy and having someone to love as much as I love my husband Roland and having a little boy that is a mixture of the both of us.
quotes.author: Ashton Shepherd

quotes.quote: I'm always swimming forward like a shark. You just keep going and you don't rest. I love waking up knowing that I have a problem to solve.
quotes.author: Nile Rodgers

quotes.quote: Courage is like love; it must have hope for nourishment.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.quote: My father was a man of love. He always loved me to death. He worked hard in the fields, but my father never hit me. Never. I don't ever remember a really cross, unkind word from my father.
quotes.author: Johnny Cash

quotes.quote: Love of beauty is taste. The creation of beauty is art.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: The story of a love is not important-what is important is that one is capable of love. It is perhaps the only glimpse we are permitted of eternity.
quotes.author: Helen Hayes

quotes.quote: To control the breathing is to control the mind. With different patterns of breathing, you can fall in love, you can hate someone, you can feel the whole spectrum of feelings just by changing your breathing.
quotes.author: Marina Abramovic

quotes.quote: If you cannot inspire a woman with love of you, fill her above the brim with love of herself; all that runs over will be yours.
quotes.author: Charles Caleb Colton

quotes.quote: The one you love and the one who loves you are never, ever the same person.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Invisible Monsters

quotes.quote: I love a massage. I'd go every day if I could. I don't need to be wrapped in herbs like a salmon fillet, but I do love a massage.
quotes.author: Jason Bateman

quotes.quote: I love to sing. Mostly about love and sex.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Berkley

quotes.quote: The new 'Joy' was needed for a number of reasons. Recent developments in nutrition and new ingredients were two of the major reasons for the revision. One of the other big reasons was America's new love for big flavors. Yay!
quotes.author: Irma S. Rombauer

quotes.quote: The thing about Mumbai is you go five yards and all of human existence is revealed. It's an incredible cavalcade of life, and I love that.
quotes.author: Julian Sands

quotes.quote: You either love or you hate. You live in the middle, you get nothing.
quotes.author: Charlie Sheen

quotes.quote: It's possible to love a human being if you don't know them too well.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski

quotes.quote: Animals have never betrayed me. They are an easy prey, as I have been throughout my career. So we feel the same. I love them.
quotes.author: Brigitte Bardot

quotes.quote: The spirit of Christmas is the spirit of love and of generosity and of goodness. It illuminates the picture window of the soul, and we look out upon the world's busy life and become more interested in people than in things.
quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson

quotes.quote: Only a struggle twists sentimentality and lust together into love.
quotes.author: E. M. Forster

quotes.quote: I just love real characters; they're not pretentious, and every emotion is on the surface, they're regular working people. Their likes, their dislikes, their loves, their hates, their passions; they're all right there on the surface.
quotes.author: David O. Russell

quotes.quote: I love dressing up and doing the red carpet every once in a while, but I am very much a jeans kinda girl, so it's all a little embarrassing for me.
quotes.author: Kelly Clarkson

quotes.quote: Brazil is where I belong, the place that feels like home. They love their family, their country and God, and are not afraid to let anybody know it.
quotes.author: Dionne Warwick

quotes.quote: To love means loving the unlovable. To forgive means pardoning the unpardonable. Faith means believing the unbelievable. Hope means hoping when everything seems hopeless.
quotes.author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: I'd love to knock an audience cold with one note, but what do you do for the rest of the evening?
quotes.author: Eric Clapton

quotes.quote: I've heard too many times where people say that I'm this ultra-serious guy. In truth, I've got an extremely absurd sense of humor. I thrive on the absurd - I love it.
quotes.author: Phil Anselmo

quotes.quote: I like to believe that love is a reciprocal thing, that it can't really be felt, truly, by one.
quotes.author: Sean Penn

quotes.quote: Girls had never been important. I'd had a girlfriend or two and had liked them a lot but it wasn't love, because my first love was tennis.
quotes.author: Boris Becker

quotes.quote: I just can't seem to write songs about peace and love. Yeah right, how do you get that?
quotes.author: Siobhan Fahey

quotes.quote: Hatred does not cease by hatred, but only by love; this is the eternal rule.
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.quote: To love oneself is the beginning of a lifelong romance.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Love is the triumph of imagination over intelligence.
quotes.author: H. L. Mencken

quotes.quote: I think it's because it's so different and it takes risks. Plus, it's really smart humor. It gives the audience credit in terms of not needing to tell them when to laugh. I love that about the show. There's no laugh track.
quotes.author: Sarah Chalke

quotes.quote: The first duty of love is to listen.
quotes.author: Paul Tillich

quotes.quote: True love comes quietly, without banners or flashing lights. If you hear bells, get your ears checked.
quotes.author: Erich Segal

quotes.quote: We are all born for love. It is the principle of existence, and its only end.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: Some people don't understand the promises they're making when they make them,"I said."Right, of course. But you keep the promise anyway. That's what love is. Love is keeping the promise anyway.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: I would love to close my eyes and see myself with my girlfriend when we're 99 years old and I have a pipe and she's knitting a sweater, and I hope that's the way it goes. I think it's a challenge every day.
quotes.author: Chris Messina

quotes.quote: One does not fall in love; one grows into love, and love grows in him.
quotes.author: Karl A. Menninger

quotes.quote: The degree of loving is measured by the degree of giving.
quotes.author: Edwin Louis Cole

quotes.quote: I love you as certain dark things are to be loved, in secret, between the shadow and the soul.
quotes.author: Pablo Neruda,  100 Love Sonnets

quotes.quote: Only divine love bestows the keys of knowledge.
quotes.author: Arthur Rimbaud

quotes.quote: Love ceases to be a pleasure when it ceases to be a secret.
quotes.author: Aphra Behn

quotes.quote: Love is a better teacher than duty.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Love is but the discovery of ourselves in others, and the delight in the recognition.
quotes.author: Alexander Smith

quotes.quote: It is my goal to love everyone. I hate no one. Regardless of their race, religion, their proclivities, the desire of their heart and how they want to live their life and the decisions that they make. I can even respect people's decisions and lifestyle choices just as I hope they have the courtesy to respect my decisions and my choices.
quotes.author: Kirk Cameron

quotes.quote: True love is eternal, infinite, and always like itself. It is equal and pure, without violent demonstrations: it is seen with white hairs and is always young in the heart.
quotes.author: Honore de Balzac

quotes.quote: Love is an emotion experienced by the many and enjoyed by the few.
quotes.author: George Jean Nathan

quotes.quote: This is part of the involuntary bargain we make with the world just by being alive. We get to experiences the splendor of nature, the beauty of art, the balm of love and the sheer joy of existence, always with the knowledge that illness, injury, natural disaster, or pure evil can end it in an instant for ourselves or someone we love.
quotes.author: Jeff Greenfield

quotes.quote: Love is a sacred reserve of energy; it is like the blood of spiritual evolution.
quotes.author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

quotes.quote: Stolen kisses are always sweetest.
quotes.author: Leigh Hunt

quotes.quote: In the flush of love's light, we dare be brave. And suddenly we see that love costs all we are, and will ever be. Yet it is only love which sets us free.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: Love is of all passions the strongest, for it attacks simultaneously the head, the heart and the senses.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.quote: A loving heart is the truest wisdom.
quotes.author: Charles Dickens

quotes.quote: Love is space and time measured by the heart.
quotes.author: Marcel Proust

quotes.quote: Let no one who loves be unhappy, even love unreturned has its rainbow.
quotes.author: James M. Barrie

quotes.quote: Love is the difficult realization that something other than oneself is real.
quotes.author: Iris Murdoch

quotes.quote: There is no remedy for love but to love more.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: A pair of powerful spectacles has sometimes sufficed to cure a person in love.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Men love it. They have a sense of humor, whereas a lot of women are threatened or just don't get it.
quotes.author: Lara Flynn Boyle

quotes.quote: Someday, after mastering the winds, the waves, the tides and gravity, we shall harness for God the energies of love, and then, for a second time in the history of the world, man will have discovered fire.
quotes.author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

quotes.quote: I'm not saying that love always takes you to heaven. Your life can become a nightmare. But that said, it is worth taking the risk.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: I do not think there is any thrill that can go through the human heart like that felt by the inventor as he sees some creation of the brain unfolding to success... such emotions make a man forget food, sleep, friends, love, everything.
quotes.author: Nikola Tesla

quotes.quote: Before I met my husband, I'd never fallen in love. I'd stepped in it a few times.
quotes.author: Rita Rudner

quotes.quote: Love means to love that which is unlovable; or it is no virtue at all.
quotes.author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: The love we have in our youth is superficial compared to the love that an old man has for his old wife.
quotes.author: Will Durant

quotes.quote: Love is... never asking for more than you are prepared to give.
quotes.author: Kim Casali

quotes.quote: God proved His love on the Cross. When Christ hung, and bled, and died, it was God saying to the world, 'I love you.'
quotes.author: Billy Graham

quotes.quote: Lord, make me an instrument of thy peace. Where there is hatred, let me sow love.
quotes.author: Francis of Assisi

quotes.quote: The beauty of a woman must be seen from in her eyes, because that is the doorway to her heart, the place where love resides.
quotes.author: Audrey Hepburn

quotes.quote: Love is needing someone. Love is putting up with someone's bad qualities because they somehow complete you.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  This Lullaby

quotes.quote: The love of family and the admiration of friends is much more important than wealth and privilege.
quotes.author: Charles Kuralt

quotes.quote: A birthday is just another day where you go to work and people give you love. Age is just a state of mind, and you are as old as you think you are. You have to count your blessings and be happy.
quotes.author: Abhishek Bachchan

quotes.quote: Love myself I do. Not everything, but I love the good as well as the bad. I love my crazy lifestyle, and I love my hard discipline. I love my freedom of speech and the way my eyes get dark when I'm tired. I love that I have learned to trust people with my heart, even if it will get broken. I am proud of everything that I am and will become.
quotes.author: Johnny Weir

quotes.quote: Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: If you love someone, set them free. If they come back they're yours; if they don't they never were.
quotes.author: Richard Bach

quotes.quote: There is only one secure foundation: a genuine, deep relationship with Jesus Christ, which will carry you through any and all turmoil. No matter what storms are raging all around, you'll stand firm if you stand on His love.
quotes.author: Charles Stanley

quotes.quote: I did nothing to deserve God's love; in fact, I was living as an orphan, without hope. Yet God chose to pursue a relationship with me, and through the death of his son Jesus, I was adopted into God's family.
quotes.author: Steven Curtis Chapman

quotes.quote: There is always some madness in love. But there is also always some reason in madness.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: A very small degree of hope is sufficient to cause the birth of love.
quotes.author: Stendhal

quotes.quote: When you arise in the morning, think of what a precious privilege it is to be alive - to breathe, to think, to enjoy, to love.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: No, there's nothing half so sweet in life as love's young dream.
quotes.author: Thomas Moore

quotes.quote: Mama was my greatest teacher, a teacher of compassion, love and fearlessness. If love is sweet as a flower, then my mother is that sweet flower of love.
quotes.author: Stevie Wonder

quotes.quote: Love, hope, fear, faith - these make humanity; These are its sign and note and character.
quotes.author: Robert Browning

quotes.quote: The more often we see the things around us - even the beautiful and wonderful things - the more they become invisible to us. That is why we often take for granted the beauty of this world: the flowers, the trees, the birds, the clouds - even those we love. Because we see things so often, we see them less and less.
quotes.author: Joseph B. Wirthlin

quotes.quote: Beauty is when you can appreciate yourself. When you love yourself, that's when you're most beautiful.
quotes.author: Zoe Kravitz

quotes.quote: Success is no accident. It is hard work, perseverance, learning, studying, sacrifice and most of all, love of what you are doing or learning to do.
quotes.author: Pele

quotes.quote: I love my daddy. My daddy's everything. I hope I can find a man that will treat me as good as my dad.
quotes.author: Lady Gaga

quotes.quote: I no longer believed in the idea of soul mates, or love at first sight. But I was beginning to believe that a very few times in your life, if you were lucky, you might meet someone who was exactly right for you. Not because he was perfect, or because you were, but because your combined flaws were arranged in a way that allowed two separate beings to hinge together.
quotes.author: Lisa Kleypas,  Blue-Eyed Devil

quotes.quote: Happiness cannot be traveled to, owned, earned, worn or consumed. Happiness is the spiritual experience of living every minute with love, grace, and gratitude.
quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs. Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth. It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.
quotes.author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: New International Version

quotes.quote: We must develop and maintain the capacity to forgive. He who is devoid of the power to forgive is devoid of the power to love. There is some good in the worst of us and some evil in the best of us. When we discover this, we are less prone to hate our enemies.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: I refuse to accept the view that mankind is so tragically bound to the starless midnight of racism and war that the bright daybreak of peace and brotherhood can never become a reality... I believe that unarmed truth and unconditional love will have the final word.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: There is a sacredness in tears. They are not the mark of weakness, but of power. They speak more eloquently than ten thousand tongues. They are the messengers of overwhelming grief, of deep contrition, and of unspeakable love.
quotes.author: Washington Irving

quotes.quote: The Opera was a very cold film, a hopeless and dark film, no hope, no love.
quotes.author: Dario Argento

quotes.quote: But I say to you, Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, so that you may be sons of your Father who is in heaven; for he makes his sun rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.
quotes.author: Jesus Christ

quotes.quote: We've got this gift of love, but love is like a precious plant. You can't just accept it and leave it in the cupboard or just think it's going to get on by itself. You've got to keep watering it. You've got to really look after it and nurture it.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: I really do believe that God is love, one of deep affection and grace and forgiveness and inspiration.
quotes.author: William P. Young

quotes.quote: I have a deep love for life and my fellow human beings. I try to understand everything that everybody does, even if it seems wrong to me.
quotes.author: Steve Vai

quotes.quote: I love you the more in that I believe you had liked me for my own sake and for nothing else.
quotes.author: John Keats

quotes.quote: Pursue some path, however narrow and crooked, in which you can walk with love and reverence.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: When I despair, I remember that all through history the way of truth and love have always won. There have been tyrants and murderers, and for a time, they can seem invincible, but in the end, they always fall. Think of it--always.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: A dog is the only thing on earth that loves you more than you love yourself.
quotes.author: Josh Billings

quotes.quote: I love deadlines. I like the whooshing sound they make as they fly by.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams

quotes.quote: Who will tell whether one happy moment of love or the joy of breathing or walking on a bright morning and smelling the fresh air, is not worth all the suffering and effort which life implies.
quotes.author: Erich Fromm

quotes.quote: Black as the devil, hot as hell, pure as an angel, sweet as love.
quotes.author: Charles Maurice de Talleyrand

quotes.quote: We loved with a love that was more than love.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: Woe to the man whose heart has not learned while young to hope, to love - and to put its trust in life.
quotes.author: Joseph Conrad

quotes.quote: For small creatures such as we the vastness is bearable only through love.
quotes.author: Carl Sagan

quotes.quote: Man must evolve for all human conflict a method which rejects revenge, aggression and retaliation. The foundation of such a method is love.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: A woman knows the face of the man she loves as a sailor knows the open sea.
quotes.author: Honore de Balzac

quotes.quote: Affection is responsible for nine-tenths of whatever solid and durable happiness there is in our lives.
quotes.author: C. S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Lord, grant that I might not so much seek to be loved as to love.
quotes.author: Francis of Assisi

quotes.quote: You are, and always have been, my dream.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Notebook

quotes.quote: At the center of non-violence stands the principle of love.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: Love has no age, no limit; and no death.
quotes.author: John Galsworthy

quotes.quote: A part of kindness consists in loving people more than they deserve.
quotes.author: Joseph Joubert

quotes.quote: Love is the joy of the good, the wonder of the wise, the amazement of the Gods.
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.quote: You are my best friend as well as my lover, and I do not know which side of you I enjoy the most. I treasure each side, just as I have treasured our life together.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Notebook

quotes.quote: We love the things we love for what they are.
quotes.author: Robert Frost

quotes.quote: Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.
quotes.author: Emily Bronte

quotes.quote: One is loved because one is loved. No reason is needed for loving.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Alchemist

quotes.quote: The greatest pleasure of life is love.
quotes.author: Euripides

quotes.quote: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you.
quotes.author: Jesus Christ

quotes.quote: I love Sell Out, I think it's great. I love the jingles. The whole thing as an album is a wonderful piece of work. The cover. Everything about it. It's got humor, great songs, irony.
quotes.author: Roger Daltrey

quotes.quote: Love has no errors, for all errors are the want for love.
quotes.author: William Law

quotes.quote: Perhaps all the dragons in our lives are princesses who are only waiting to see us act, just once, with beauty and courage. Perhaps everything that frightens us is, in its deepest essence, something helpless that wants our love.
quotes.author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  Letters to a Young Poet

quotes.quote: Be of love a little more careful than of anything.
quotes.author: e. e. cummings

quotes.quote: Love is always bestowed as a gift - freely, willingly and without expectation. We don't love to be loved; we love to love.
quotes.author: Leo Buscaglia

quotes.quote: Love is a game that two can play and both win.
quotes.author: Eva Gabor

quotes.quote: True love cannot be found where it does not exist, nor can it be denied where it does.
quotes.author: Torquato Tasso

quotes.quote: I would die for you. But I won't live for you.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: As soon go kindle fire with snow, as seek to quench the fire of love with words.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.quote: In vain have I struggled. It will not do. My feelings will not be repressed. You must allow me to tell you how ardently I admire and love you.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Pride And Prejudice

quotes.quote: Love is the greatest gift that God has given us. It's free.
quotes.author: Taraji P. Henson

quotes.quote: A kiss is a rosy dot over the 'i' of loving.
quotes.author: Cyrano de Bergerac

quotes.quote: For thousands of years, human beings have been obsessed with beauty, truth, love, honor, altruism, courage, social relationships, art, and God. They all go together as subjective experiences, and it's a straw man to set God up as the delusion. If he is, then so is truth itself or beauty itself.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra

quotes.quote: Love does not begin and end the way we seem to think it does. Love is a battle, love is a war; love is a growing up.
quotes.author: James A. Baldwin

quotes.quote: Promise me you'll always remember: You're braver than you believe, and stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne

quotes.quote: Like all of us in this storm between birth and death, I can wreak no great changes on the world, only small changes for the better, I hope, in the lives of those I love.
quotes.author: Dean Koontz

quotes.quote: Love is a hole in the heart.
quotes.author: Ben Hecht

quotes.quote: I have this idyllic love life, but my mind just won't accept that. I would like to bring a new guy home every night. I try to make humor out of that situation.
quotes.author: Jen Kirkman

quotes.quote: I don't know that love changes. People change. Circumstances change.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks

quotes.quote: Your ordinary acts of love and hope point to the extraordinary promise that every human life is of inestimable value.
quotes.author: Desmond Tutu

quotes.quote: I am happier when I love than when I am loved. I adore my husband, my son, my grandchildren, my mother, my dog, and frankly, I don't know if they even like me. But who cares? Loving them is my joy.
quotes.author: Isabel Allende

quotes.quote: Nowadays love is a matter of chance, matrimony a matter of money and divorce a matter of course.
quotes.author: Helen Rowland

quotes.quote: Listen to your inner-voice: Surround yourself with loving, nurturing people. Fall in love with your art and find yourself. Music is the great communicator.
quotes.author: Glenn Hughes

quotes.quote: I'm a people person, very approachable. I go out every night, tons of functions. I love all facets of this industry... Music, film, TV, books, art. I love being around creative people.
quotes.author: Guy Oseary

quotes.quote: The one thing I don't consume during 'Today' - which surprises many people - is coffee. I find that a lot of water helps wake me up, without the buzz. I love coffee, but usually reserve a double espresso as an afternoon pick-me-up before settling in to do the weekend 'Nightly News.'
quotes.author: Lester Holt

quotes.quote: I hope somebody falls in love with me - other than my fiancee. But that's what you want. As a player you want a team that really wants you; head coach, GM, owner, everybody that really wants you in their place and the players believe in you. I'm looking forward to making somebody fall in love with me.
quotes.author: Robert Griffin III

quotes.quote: I love a vintage look that's also a bit rock n' roll.
quotes.author: Cara Delevingne

quotes.quote: Wine comes in at the mouth And love comes in at the eye; That's all we shall know for truth Before we grow old and die.
quotes.author: William Butler Yeats

quotes.quote: If a person loves only one other person and is indifferent to all others, his love is not love but a symbiotic attachment, or an enlarged egotism.
quotes.author: Erich Fromm

quotes.quote: I think relationships are work, but love is a gift.
quotes.author: Anne Hathaway

quotes.quote: Lot's wife, of course, was told not to look back where all those people and their homes had been. But she did look back, and I love her for that, because it was so human.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut

quotes.quote: When we love, we always strive to become better than we are. When we strive to become better than we are, everything around us becomes better too.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Alchemist

quotes.quote: There's something about Southern women that is so unique yet so universal. Strong southern women are allowed to be soft and feminine and have a sense of humor. But what I love about Southern women in particular is their universality.
quotes.author: Connie Britton

quotes.quote: It is in the thirties that we want friends. In the forties we know they won't save us any more than love did.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: Being a survivor doesn't mean being strong - it's telling people when you need a meal or a ride, company, whatever. It's paying attention to heart wisdom, feelings, not living a role, but having a unique, authentic life, having something to contribute, finding time to love and laugh. All these things are qualities of survivors.
quotes.author: Bernie Siegel

quotes.quote: I honestly, sincerely love what I do.
quotes.author: Mary Hart

quotes.quote: My hope is that we continue to nurture the places that we love, but that we also look outside our immediate worlds.
quotes.author: Annie Leibovitz

quotes.quote: Art is not necessary at all. All that is necessary to make this world a better place to live in is to love - to love as Christ loved, as Buddha loved.
quotes.author: Isadora Duncan

quotes.quote: They are always saying God loves us. If that's love I'd rather have a bit of kindness.
quotes.author: Graham Greene

quotes.quote: Sometimes you're afraid to fall in love with a chick, but she sucks you in anyway.
quotes.author: Sammy Hagar

quotes.quote: Man's only true happiness is to live in hope of something to be won by him. Reverence something to be worshipped by him, and love something to be cherished by him, forever.
quotes.author: John Ruskin

quotes.quote: People like to think of you as a certain person, or a certain type of person, and they do love to give you a label. We like luggage labels, and we like people labels.
quotes.author: Clare Balding

quotes.quote: Love is not altogether a delirium, yet it has many points in common therewith.
quotes.author: Thomas Carlyle

quotes.quote: You can't force love, I realized. It's there or it isn't. If it's not there, you've got to be able to admit it. If it is there, you've got to do whatever it takes to protect the ones you love.
quotes.author: Richelle Mead,  Frostbite

quotes.quote: I love going to the movie theatre, seeing live comedy, and going to amusement parks.
quotes.author: Jennette McCurdy

quotes.quote: I love mankind; it's people I can't stand.
quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz

quotes.quote: Part of my humor is the fact that I love coming out of left field. I don't want people to expect what is going to happen next.

quotes.quote: When I really love someone, I can only show it by making aggressive and bad-taste remarks.

quotes.author: Jennifer Lopez

quotes.quote: Love involves a peculiar unfathomable combination of understanding and misunderstanding.

quotes.author: Christian Louboutin

quotes.quote: Women love always: when earth slips from them, they take refuge in heaven.
quotes.author: George Sand

quotes.quote: Love is the magician that pulls man out of his own hat.
quotes.author: Ben Hecht

quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson

quotes.quote: Love is always patient and kind. It is never jealous. Love is never boastful or conceited. It is never rude or selfish. It does not take offense and is not resentful. quotes.author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: New International Version

quotes.quote: This love is silent.

quotes.quote: 'Life, Love & Hope' is... I'm thinking 'larger picture.' I'm not trying to preach to anyone. We all get lost and caught up in our everyday problems. quotes.author: Tom Scholz

quotes.quote: Looking back, I have this to regret, that too often when I loved, I did not say so.

quotes.quote: All life is a manifestation of the spirit, the manifestation of love.

quotes.quote: Life is like an onion. You peel it off one layer at a time, and sometimes you weep.
quotes.author: Carl Sandburg

quotes.quote: The human soul is hungry for beauty; we seek it everywhere - in landscape, music, art, clothes, furniture, gardening, companionship, love, religion, and in ourselves. No one would desire not to be beautiful. When we experience the beautiful, there is a sense of homecoming.

quotes.quote: If equal affection cannot be, let the more loving be me.

quotes.quote: Two people in love, alone, isolated from the world, that's beautiful.

quotes.quote: Each moment of a happy lover's hour is worth an age of dull and common life.
quotes.author: Aphra Behn

quotes.author: Luc de Clapiers

quotes.quote: Who ever loved that loved not at first sight?

quotes.author: Elizabeth Gillies

quotes.quote: Any time not spent on love is wasted.
quotes.author: Torquato Tasso

quotes.quote: Being in love is the only transcendent experience.
quotes.author: Armistead Maupin

quotes.quote: The heart was made to be broken.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: You will find as you look back upon your life that the moments when you have truly lived are the moments when you have done things in the spirit of love.
quotes.author: Henry Drummond

quotes.quote: Resentments and grudges are two of the main culprits that perpetuate cycles of self-abuse and victimhood. Stowed away inside you like parasites, they deplete you of your God-given life force and separate you from your inherent worth, your joy, and the love in your heart.
quotes.author: Debbie Ford

quotes.quote: My love of fine art increased - the more of it I saw, the more of it I wanted to see.
quotes.author: J. Paul Getty

quotes.quote: Love seeks one thing only: the good of the one loved. It leaves all the other secondary effects to take care of themselves. Love, therefore, is its own reward.

quotes.quote: Love is supreme and unconditional; like is nice but limited.
quotes.author: Duke Ellington

quotes.quote: Loving others always costs us something and requires effort. And you have to decide to do it on purpose. You can't wait for a feeling to motivate you.
quotes.author: Joyce Meyer

quotes.quote: At the touch of love everyone becomes a poet.
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.quote: Everything is clearer when you're in love.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: Do not seek the because - in love there is no because, no reason, no explanation, no solutions.
quotes.author: Anais Nin

quotes.quote: This above all: to thine own self be true, And it must follow, as the night the day, Thou canst not then be false to any man.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Hamlet

quotes.quote: They didn't agree on much. In fact, they didn't agree on anything. They fought all the time and challenged each other ever day. But despite their differences, they had one important thing in common. They were crazy about each other.

quotes.quote: Sexual living is a reflection of God's love for us. It has two key qualities, which is faithfulness and creativity of new life.
quotes.author: Vincent Nichols

quotes.quote: The richest love is that which submits to the arbitration of time.
quotes.author: Lawrence Durrell

quotes.quote: Didn't Lionel Richie just make a country album? No one is giving him a hard time... and God bless him - I love Lionel and should be able to do what he wants to do, like Madonna should, too. Both are having success and I applaud them. quotes.author: Amy Sedaris,  I Like You: Hospitality Under the Influence

quotes.quote: I don't care if you're black, white, straight, bisexual, gay, lesbian, short, tall, fat, skinny, rich or poor. If you're nice to me, I'll be nice to you. Simple as that.
quotes.author: Robert Michaels MD - 2007 - Graduation Speaker

quotes.quote: She didn't belong anywhere and she never really belonged to anyone. And everyone else belonged somewhere and to someone. People thought she was too wonderful. But she only wanted to belong to someone. People always thought she was too wonderful to belong to them or that something too wonderful would hurt too much to lose. And that's why she liked him-- because he just thought she was crazy.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Let us dream of tomorrow where we can truly love from the soul, and know love as the ultimate truth at the heart of all creation.
quotes.author: Michael Jackson

quotes.quote: Forgiveness is the final form of love.
quotes.author: Reinhold Niebuhr

quotes.quote: Some people feel like they don't deserve love. They walk away quietly into empty spaces, trying to close the gaps of the past.
quotes.author: Jon Krakauer,  Into the Wild

quotes.quote: Gentle reader, may you never feel what I then felt! May your eyes never shed such stormy, scalding, heart-wrung tears as poured from mine. May you never appeal to Heaven in prayers so hopeless and so agised as in that hour left my lips: for never may you, like me, dread to be the instrument of evil to what you wholly love.
quotes.author: Charlotte BrontÃ«,  Jane Eyre

quotes.quote: Then, one stupid person, no different from any other stupid person, wanders into your stupid life...you give them a piece of you. They don't ask for it. They do something dumb one day like kiss you or smile at you, and then your life isn't your own anymore.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  The Sandman, Vol. 9: The Kindly Ones

quotes.quote: One day, when I am a braver man, I will tell her these things, and then I will look her in the eye tell her I love her and ask her to be only mine. But until that day, we're just friends.
quotes.author: Charlie Huston,  Already Dead

quotes.quote: Goodbyes are only for those who love with their eyes. Because for those who love with heart and soul there is no such thing as separation.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.quote: You always get more respect when you don't have a happy ending.
quotes.author: Julia Quinn

quotes.quote: We, the People, recognize that we have responsibilities as well as rights; that our destinies are bound together; that a freedom which only asks what's in it for me, a freedom without a commitment to others, a freedom without love or charity or duty or patriotism, is unworthy of our founding ideals, and those who died in their defense.
quotes.author: Barack Obama

quotes.quote: I'm in love with you, and I know that love is just a shout into the void, and that oblivion is inevitable, and that we're all doomed and that there will come a day when all our labor has been returned to dust, and I know the sun will swallow the only earth we'll ever have, and I am in love with you.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: We die to each other daily. What we know of other people is only our memory of the moments during which we knew them. And they have changed since then. To pretend that they and we are the same is a useful and convenient social convention which must sometimes be broken. We must also remember that at every meeting we are meeting a stranger.
quotes.author: T.S. Eliot,  The Cocktail Party

quotes.quote: I belong to the people I love, and they belong to me--they, and the love and loyaty I give them, form my identity far more than any word or group ever could.
quotes.author: Veronica Roth,  Allegiant

quotes.quote: Here's something else to think about: calling when you say you're going to is the very first brick in the house you are building of love and trust. If he can't lay this one stupid brick down, you ain't never gonna have a house baby, and it's cold outside.
quotes.author: Greg Behrendt,  He's Just Not That Into You: The No-Excuses Truth to Understanding Guys

quotes.quote: I met an old lady once, almost a hundred years old, and she told me, 'There are only two questions that human beings have ever fought over, all through history. How much do you love me? And Who's in charge?
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

quotes.quote: There is no love without forgiveness, and there is no forgiveness without love.
quotes.author: Bryant H. McGill

quotes.quote: In this world, it is too common for people to search for someone to lose themselves in. But I am already lost. I will look for someone to find myself in.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Keep your best wishes, close to your heart and watch what happens
quotes.author: Tony DeLiso,  Legacy: The Power Within

quotes.quote: So it's true, when all is said and done, grief is the price we pay for love.
quotes.author: E.A. Bucchianeri,  Brushstrokes of a Gadfly

quotes.quote: Falling for him would be like cliff diving. It would be either the most exhilarating thing that ever happened to me or the stupidest mistake I'd ever make.
quotes.author: Colleen Houck

quotes.quote: There is no pretending",Jace said with absolute clarity."I love you,and I will love you until I die,and if there's a life after that,I'll love you then."She caught her breath.He had said it-the words there was no going back from.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Glass

quotes.quote: We live in a world of constant juxtaposition between joy that's possible and pain that's all too common. We hope for love and success and abundance, but we never quite forget that there is always lurking the possibility of disaster.
quotes.author: Marianne Williamson

quotes.quote: Since love grows within you, so beauty grows. For love is the beauty of the soul.
quotes.author: Saint Augustine

quotes.quote: In secret we met -In silence I grieve,That thy heart could forget,Thy spirit deceive.If I should meet theeAfter long years,How should I greet thee? -With silence and tears
quotes.author: George Gordon Byron

quotes.quote: Romance novels are birthday cake and life is often peanut butter and jelly. I think everyone should have lots of delicious romance novels lying around for those times when the peanut butter of life gets stuck to the roof of your mouth.
quotes.author: Janet Evanovich

quotes.quote: If I am to be fallen into love, I will. And if as a result I will appear to be stupid, disillusioned, and of poor judgment, I will. And I would be damned if I cared what other people think. For I would rather be thought of as all of these things, than not love. If in loving, I become the naked woman on the horse, I will ride that horse with my head held high. This is my spirit. I am unbreakable.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: The voice of Love seemed to call to me, but it was a wrong number.
quotes.author: P.G. Wodehouse,  Very Good, Jeeves!

quotes.quote: When the power of love overcomes the love of power the world will know peace.
quotes.author: Jimi Hendrix

quotes.quote: The love that moves the sun and the other stars.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert

quotes.quote: For never was a story of more woe than this of Juliet and her Romeo.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

quotes.author: Taylor Swift

quotes.quote: Last time I saw you, I said that it hurt too much to love you. But I was wrong about that. The truth is it hurts too much not to love you.
quotes.author: P.C. Cast

quotes.quote: How far should a person go in the name of true love?
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Choice

quotes.quote: Of course it hurt that we could never love each other in a physical way. We would have been far more happy if we had. But that was like the tides, the change of seasons--something immutable, an immovable destiny we could never alter. No matter how cleverly we might shelter it, our delicate friendship wasn't going to last forever. We were bound to reach a dead end. That was painfully clear.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Sputnik Sweetheart

quotes.quote: nothing in this world was more difficult than love.
quotes.author: Gabriel GarcÃ­Â­a MÃ¡rquez

quotes.quote: Accept the things to which fate binds you, and love the people with whom fate brings you together,but do so with all your heart.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

"I don't buy it for a second, 'cause if you were my girlfriend and a stud like me was livin' in your house, I'd kiss you in front of the guy every chance I got as a reminder.""A reminder of w-w-what?""That you were mine.
quotes.author: Simone Elkeles,  Rules of Attraction

quotes.quote: Someday, we'll run into each other again, I know it.Maybe I'll be older and smarter and just plain better. If that happens,that's when I'll deserve you. But now, at this moment, you can't hook your boat to mine, because I'm liable to sink us both.
quotes.author: Gabrielle Zevin,  Memoirs of a Teenage Amnesiac

quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

But I truly believe that the only way you can find out that there's something better out there is to first believe there's something better out there. What other choice is there?
quotes.author: Greg Behrendt,  He's Just Not That Into You

quotes.quote: Love, the poet said, is woman's whole existence.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  Orlando

quotes.quote: Forgive the past. It is over. Learn from it and let go. People are constantly changing and growing. Do not cling to a limited, disconnected, negative image of a person in the past. See that person now. Your relationship is always alive and changing.
quotes.author: Brian L. Weiss,  Messages from the Masters: Tapping Into the Power of Love

quotes.quote: I'm gonna fight for you, until your heart stops beating.
quotes.author: Stephenie Meyer,  Eclipse

quotes.quote: My friends and family are my support system. They tell me what I need to hear, not what I want to hear and they are there for me in the good and bad times. Without them I have no idea where I would be and I know that their love for me is what's keeping my head above the water.
quotes.author: Kelly Clarkson

quotes.quote: Sleep my little baby-ohSleep until you wakenWhen you wake you'll see the worldIf I'm not mistaken...Kiss a loverDance a measure,Find your nameAnd buried treasure...Face your lifeIts pain, Its pleasure,Leave no path untaken.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  The Graveyard Book

quotes.quote: Love. The reason I dislike that word is that it means too much for me, far more than you can understand."- Anna Karenina {Anna Karenina}
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

quotes.quote: A deep sense of love and belonging is an irreducible need of all people. We are biologically, cognitively, physically, and spiritually wired to love, to be loved, and to belong. When those needs are not met, we don't function as we were meant to. We break. We fall apart. We numb. We ache. We hurt others. We get sick.
quotes.author: Brene Brown

quotes.quote: To love is to suffer. To avoid suffering one must not love. But then one suffers from not loving. Therefore, to love is to suffer; not to love is to suffer; to suffer is to suffer. To be happy is to love. To be happy, then, is to suffer, but suffering makes one unhappy. Therefore, to be happy one must love or love to suffer or suffer from too much happiness.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: I don't care what you say to me. I care what you share with me.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar,  Quote Me Everyday

quotes.quote: The future for me is already a thing of the past -You were my first love and you will be my last
quotes.author: Bob Dylan,  Bob Dylan - Love and Theft: Piano/Vocal/Guitar

quotes.quote: If you ever looked at me once with what I know is in you, I would be your slave.
quotes.author: Emily BrontÃ«,  Wuthering Heights

quotes.quote: Every true love and friendship is a story of unexpected transformation. If we are the same person before and after we loved, that means we haven't loved enough.
quotes.author: Elif Shafak,  The Forty Rules of Love

quotes.quote: We all know him to be a proud, unpleasant sort of man; but this would be nothing if you really liked him.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

quotes.quote: True love stories never have endings.
quotes.author: Richard Bach

quotes.quote: Why is love intensified by absence?
quotes.author: Audrey Niffenegger,  The Time Traveler's Wife

quotes.quote: After all, what is happiness? Love, they tell me. But love doesn't bring and never has brought happiness. On the contrary, it's a constant state of anxiety, a battlefield; it's sleepless nights, asking ourselves all the time if we're doing the right thing. Real love is composed of ecstasy and agony.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Witch Of Portobello

quotes.quote: You are my heart, my life, my entire existence."-Ash
quotes.author: Julie Kagawa,  The Iron Queen

quotes.quote: If I love you, what business is it of yours?
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.quote: I envy people that know love. That have someone who takes them as they are.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  The Devilin Fey

quotes.quote: They do not love that do not show their love.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  The Two Gentlemen of Verona

quotes.quote: Motherhood: All love begins and ends there.
quotes.author: Robert Browning

quotes.quote: I love you,"he whispered, and that was the moment he knew what he was going to do. When you loved someone, you put their needs before your own. No matter how inconceivable those needs were; no matter how fucked up; no matter how much it made you feel like you were ripping yourself into pieces.
quotes.author: Jodi Picoult,  The Pact

quotes.quote: A thousand half-loves must be forsaken to take one whole heart home.
quotes.author: Rumi,  Words of Paradise: Selected Poems of Rumi

quotes.quote: I have little left in myself -- I must have you. The world may laugh -- may call me absurd, selfish -- but it does not signify. My very soul demands you: it will be satisfied, or it will take deadly vengeance on its frame.
quotes.author: Charlotte BrontÃ«,  Jane Eyre

quotes.quote: She wasn't doing a thing that I could see, except standing there leaning on the balcony railing, holding the universe together.
quotes.author: J.D. Salinger

quotes.quote: ...unrequited love does not die; it's only beaten down to a secret place where it hides, curled and wounded. For some unfortunates, it turns bitter and mean, and those who come after pay the price for the hurt done by the one who came before.
quotes.author: Elle Newmark,  The Book of Unholy Mischief

quotes.quote: We are all the pieces of what we remember. We hold in ourselves the hopes and fears of those who love us. As long as there is love and memory, there is no true loss.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Heavenly Fire

quotes.quote: I think you are wrong to want a heart. It makes most people unhappy. If you only knew it, you are in luck not to have a heart.
quotes.author: L. Frank Baum,  The Wonderful Wizard of Oz

quotes.quote: Our best hope for the future is not to get people to think of all humanity as family - that's impossible. It lies, instead, in an appreciation of the fact that, even if we don't empathize with distant strangers, their lives have the same value as the lives of those we love.
quotes.author: Paul Bloom

quotes.quote: A wedding anniversary is the celebration of love, trust, partnership, tolerance and tenacity. The order varies for any given year.
quotes.author: Paul Sweeney

quotes.quote: I just love entertaining. I will do anything - stand-up comedy, video games, fencing, internet shorts - I just want to keep being lucky enough to entertain people anyway I can. I try never to limit my art to a medium.
quotes.author: Matthew Gray Gubler

quotes.quote: If a man wants you, nothing can keep him away. If he doesn't want you, nothing can make him stay.
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey

quotes.quote: Kissing - and I mean like, yummy, smacking kissing - is the most delicious, most beautiful and passionate thing that two people can do, bar none. Better than sex, hands down.
quotes.author: Drew Barrymore

quotes.quote: This generation has lost the true meaning of romance. There are so many songs that disrespect women. You can't treat the woman you love as a piece of meat. You should treat your love like a princess. Give her love songs, something with real meaning. Maybe I'm old fashioned but to respect the woman you love should be a priority.
quotes.author: Tom Hiddleston

quotes.quote: I am my own biggest critic. Before anyone else has criticized me, I have already criticized myself. But for the rest of my life, I am going to be with me and I don't want to spend my life with someone who is always critical. So I am going to stop being my own critic. It's high time that I accept all the great things about me.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: I want to try making things right because picking up the pieces is way better than leaving them the way they are.
quotes.author: Simone Elkeles,  Perfect Chemistry

quotes.quote: Let me die the moment my love dies. Let me not outlive my own capacity to love. Let me die still loving, and so, never die.
quotes.author: Mary Zimmerman,  Metamorphoses

quotes.quote: If you love a flower that lives on a star, it is sweet to look at the sky at night. All the stars are a-bloom with flowers...
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-ExupÃ©ry,  The Little Prince

quotes.quote: If having a soul means being able to feel love and loyalty and gratitude, then animals are better off than a lot of humans.
quotes.author: James Herriot

quotes.quote: She is a friend of my mind. She gather me, man. The pieces I am, she gather them and give them back to me in all the right order.
quotes.author: Toni Morrison,  Beloved

quotes.quote: When you are missing someone, time seems to move slower, and when I'm falling in love with someone, time seems to be moving faster.
quotes.author: Taylor Swift

quotes.quote: After all these years, I see that I was mistaken about Eve in the beginning; it is better to live outside the Garden with her than inside it without her.
quotes.author: Mark Twain,  The Diaries of Adam & Eve

quotes.quote: True love is the best thing in the world, except for cough drops.

quotes.quote: Assumptions are the termites of relationships.
quotes.author: Henry Winkler

quotes.quote: I will not try to convince you to love me, to respect me, to commit to me. I deserve better than that; I AM BETTER THAN THAT...Goodbye.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: One ought to hold on to one's heart; for if one lets it go, one soon loses control of the head too.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Jealousy is a disease, love is a healthy condition. The immature mind often mistakes one for the other, or assumes that the greater the love, the greater the jealousy - in fact, they are almost incompatible; one emotion hardly leaves room for the other.
quotes.author: Robert A. Heinlein,  Stranger in a Strange Land

quotes.quote: All my heart is yours, sir: it belongs to you; and with you it would remain, were fate to exile the rest of me from your presence forever.
quotes.author: Charlotte BrontÃ«,  Jane Eyre

quotes.quote: Love is a luxury.""No. Love is an element."An element. Like air to breathe, earth to stand on.
quotes.author: Laini Taylor,  Daughter of Smoke & Bone

quotes.quote: I'm a little pencil in the hand of a writing God, who is sending a love letter to the world.
quotes.author: Mother Teresa

quotes.quote: Her heart was a secret garden and the walls were very high.
quotes.author: William Goldman,  The Princess Bride

quotes.quote: No human relation gives one possession in another--every two souls are absolutely different. In friendship or in love, the two side by side raise hands together to find what one cannot reach alone.
quotes.author: Kahlil Gibran

quotes.quote: Friends are the family you choose (~ Nin/Ithilnin, Elven rogue).
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  The Other Side of Life

quotes.quote: But if I hadn't fallen, I wouldn't have met you.
quotes.author: Becca Fitzpatrick,  Hush, Hush

quotes.quote: Love him or hate him, Trump is a man who is certain about what he wants and sets out to get it, no holds barred. Women find his power almost as much of a turn-on as his money.
quotes.author: Donald Trump

quotes.quote: In this part of the story I am the one whodies, the only one, and I will die of love because I love you,because I love you, Love, in fire and in blood.
quotes.author: Pablo Neruda,  100 Love Sonnets

quotes.quote: Woman is sacred; the woman one loves is holy.
quotes.author: Alexandre Dumas,  The Count of Monte Cristo

quotes.quote: Where there is great love, there are always miracles.
quotes.author: Willa Cather

quotes.quote: Sometimes, you just have to clear your head and get out to see other things. It is very important to be nourished. I love to go to museums and galleries, I like to see theatre, film, dance - anything creative. It doesn't promise you inspiration, but it nourishes your creative soul, and that's good.
quotes.author: Marc Jacobs

quotes.quote: It's the kind of kiss that inspires stars to climb into the sky and light up the world.
quotes.author: Tahereh Mafi,  Ignite Me

quotes.quote: If I could but know his heart, everything would become easy.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Sense and Sensibility

quotes.quote: Each relationship between two persons is absolutely unique. That is why you cannot love two people the same. It simply is not possible. You love each person differently because of who they are and the uniqueness that they draw out of you.
quotes.author: Wm. Paul Young,  The Shack

quotes.quote: Anyone who thinks they can write the perfect comedy that everyone will love is a fool. I can only write what I think is funny and hope that there is a likeminded audience out there.
quotes.author: Brendan O'Carroll

quotes.quote: Loving someone and having them love you back is the most precious thing in the world.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Rescue

quotes.quote: He suddenly recalled from Plato's Symposium: People were hermaphrodites until God split then in two, and now all the halves wander the world over seeking one another. Love is the longing for the half of ourselves we have lost.
quotes.author: Milan Kundera,  The Unbearable Lightness Of Being

quotes.quote: I miss him in so many ways, but right now I miss him in the way you always miss someone when you're single among a room full of couples.
quotes.author: Emily Giffin,  Baby Proof

quotes.quote: Being with you and not being with you is the only way I have to measure time.
quotes.author: Jorge Luis Borges

quotes.quote: You couldn't just pick and choose at will when someone depended on you, or loved you. It wasn't like a light switch, easy to turn on or off. If you were in, you were in. Out, you were out.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Along for the Ride

quotes.quote: I think true success is intrinsic... It's love. It's kindness. It's community.
quotes.author: Tom Shadyac

quotes.quote: There are only really a few stories to tell in the end, and betrayal and the failure of love is one of those good stories to tell.
quotes.author: Sean Lennon

quotes.quote: I mean, at the end of the day, what the hell does it matter who I end up with if it can't be you?
quotes.author: Tabitha Suzuma,  Forbidden

quotes.quote: I'd love to, she finally said,"on one condition."I steadied myself, hoping it wasn't something too awful."Yes?""You have to promise that you won't fall in love with me."I knew she was kidding me by the way she laughed, and I couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.Sometimes, I had to admit, Jamie had a pretty good sense of humor.I smiled and gave her my word.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks

quotes.quote: Moving on is easy. It's staying moved on that's trickier.
quotes.author: Katerina Stoykova Klemer

quotes.quote: Oh, aye, Sassenach. I am your master . . . and you're mine. Seems I canna possess your soul without losing my own.
quotes.author: Diana Gabaldon,  Outlander

quotes.quote: Okay. Then...I can talk. Ask me something.""Okay."He laughs shakily in my ear. "Why is your heart racing Tris?"I cringe and say, "Well, I...I barely know you. I barely know you and I'm crammed up against you in a box, Four, what do you think?"..."Maybe you were cut out for Candor,"he says, "because you're a terrible liar.
quotes.author: Veronica Roth,  Divergent

quotes.quote: Friendship is a disinterested commerce between equals; love, an abject intercourse between tyrants and slaves.
quotes.author: Oliver Goldsmith

quotes.quote: Love is what you make it. Unfortunately, I can't make it today, as I have a doctor's appointment.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Nerd girls are the world's most underutilized romantic resource. And guys, do not tell me that nerd girls are not hot because that shows a Paris Hilton-esque failure to understand hotness.
quotes.author: John Green

quotes.quote: How would your life be different if...You walked away from gossip and verbal defamation? Let today be the day...You speak only the good you know of other people and encourage others to do the same.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Who could refrain that had a heart to love and in that heart courage to make love known?
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.quote: One of the things that makes me who I am is the loyalty I have to people I hold close to my heart.
quotes.author: Simone Elkeles,  Perfect Chemistry

quotes.quote: If I know what love is, it is because of you.
quotes.author: Hermann Hesse

quotes.quote: Don't sacrifice yourself too much, because if you sacrifice too much there's nothing else you can give and nobody will care for you.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: Love makes you want to be a better man--right, right. But maybe love, real love, also gives you permission to just be the man you are.
quotes.author: Gillian Flynn,  Gone Girl

quotes.quote: She leaned forward and caught at his hand, pressing it between her own. The touch was like white fire through his veins. He could not feel her skin only the cloth of her gloves, and yet it did not matter. You kindled me, heap of ashes that I am, into fire. He had wondered once why love was always phrased in terms of burning. The conflagration in his own veins, now, gave the answer.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Princess

quotes.quote: When you love you wish to do things for. You wish to sacrifice for. You wish to serve.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway,  A Farewell to Arms

quotes.quote: Such short little lives our pets have to spend with us, and they spend most of it waiting for us to come home each day. It is amazing how much love and laughter they bring into our lives and even how much closer we become with each other because of them.
quotes.author: John Grogan,  Marley and Me: Life and Love With the World's Worst Dog

quotes.quote: Stay with me.Always.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Mockingjay

quotes.quote: Oh Jake,"Brett said, "We could have had such a damned good time together."Ahead was a mounted policeman in khaki directing traffic. He raised his baton. The car slowed suddenly, pressing Brett against me.Yes,"I said. "Isn't it pretty to think so?
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway,  The Sun Also Rises

quotes.quote: Down on the lake rosy reflections of celestial vapor appeared, and I said, "God, I love you"and looked to the sky and really meant it. "I have fallen in love with you, God. Take care of us all, one way or the other."To the children and the innocent it's all the same.
quotes.author: Jack Kerouac,  The Dharma Bums

quotes.quote: Failed relationships can be described as so much wasted make-up.
quotes.author: Marian Keyes,  Watermelon

quotes.quote: It is the possibility that keeps me going, and though you may call me a dreamer or a fool or any other thing, I believe that anything is possible.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks

quotes.quote: But maybe you never really had someone, she thought now. Maybe, no matter how much you loved them, they could slip through your fingers like water, and there was nothing you could do about it.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Fallen Angels

quotes.quote: V-Day...if you need this one day in a year to show everyone else you truly care for 'your loved one' I think it's quite stupid. I hate this commercialism. It's all artificial, and has nothing to do with real love.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  EyeLeash: A Blog Novel

quotes.quote: Maybe there isn't such a thing as fate. Maybe it's just the opportunities we're given, and what we do with them. I'm beginning to think that maybe great, epic romances don't just happen. We have to make them ourselves.
quotes.author: Marissa Meyer,  Cress

quotes.quote: When you love someone, you don't have a choice. Love takes your choices away.- Clary Fray
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

quotes.quote: I really think that technology has the greatest potential to accelerate happiness of most things in the world. The companies that will ultimately do well are the companies that chase happiness. If you find a way to help people find love, or health or friendship, the dollar will chase that.
quotes.author: Ashton Kutcher

quotes.quote: Love can do much, but duty more.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.quote: You can't turn love on and off like a light switch, no matter how hard you try. All you can do is wall it off, one brick at a time, until you've created an impenetrable fortress around your emotions. And once that fortress is built, you camouflage it so well that even you can't see it anymore.
quotes.author: Katherine Allred,  The Sweet Gum Tree

quotes.quote: He sighed and then focused his eyes right on me. It was like drowning, drowning in seas of green. There was nothing in the world except for those eyes."I want to kiss you, Rose,"he said softly. "And I want you to want me too.
quotes.author: Richelle Mead,  Shadow Kiss

quotes.quote: I'll find you. There is no place in this world you can hide from me. I'm watching.Love, Dimitri
quotes.author: Richelle Mead,  Spirit Bound

quotes.quote: She's my kitten, and no one else's.
quotes.author: Jeaniene Frost,  One Foot in the Grave

quotes.quote: There is nothing on earth more beautiful to me than your smile...no sound sweeter than your laughter...no pleasure greater than holding you in my arms. I realized today that I could never live without you, stubborn little hellion that you are. In this life and the next, you're my only hope of happiness. Tell me, Lillian, dearest love...how can you have reached so far inside my heart?
quotes.author: Lisa Kleypas,  It Happened One Autumn

quotes.quote: Only in the agony of parting do we look into the depths of love.
quotes.author: George Eliot

quotes.quote: I don't like it when I outweigh my men.
quotes.author: Patricia Briggs,  Moon Called

quotes.quote: That's when I finally got it. I finally understood. It wasn't the thought that counted. It was the actual execution that mattered, the showing up for somebody. The intent behind it wasn't enough. Not for me. Not anymore. It wasn't enough to know that deep down, he loved me. You had to actually say it to somebody, show them you cared. And he just didn't. Not enough.
quotes.author: Jenny Han,  It's Not Summer Without You

quotes.quote: Love is always open arms. If you close your arms about love you will find that you are left holding only yourself.
quotes.author: Leo Buscaglia

quotes.quote: Desiring another person is perhaps the most risky endeavor of all. As soon as you want somebody--really want him--it is as though you have taken a surgical needle and sutured your happiness to the skin of that person, so that any separation will now cause a lacerating injury.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Committed: A Skeptic Makes Peace with Marriage

quotes.quote: And then the line was quite but not dead. I almost felt like he was there in my room with me, but in a way it was better, like I was not in my room and he was not in his, but instead we were together in some invisible and tenuous third space that could only be visited on the phone.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: I want everything with you, America. I want the holidays and the birthdays, the busy season and lazy weekends. I want peanut butter fingertips on my desk. I want inside jokes and fights and everything. I want a life with you.
quotes.author: Kiera Cass,  The One

quotes.quote: It takes three to make love, not two: you, your spouse, and God. Without God people only succeed in bringing out the worst in one another. Lovers who have nothing else to do but love each other soon find there is nothing else. Without a central loyalty life is unfinished.
quotes.author: Fulton J. Sheen,  Seven Words of Jesus and Mary: Lessons from Cana and Calvary

quotes.quote: Love Jo all your days, if you choose, but don't let it spoil you, for it's wicked to throw away so many good gifts because you can't have the one you want.
quotes.author: Louisa May Alcott,  Little Women

quotes.quote: Love wins, love always wins.
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  Tuesdays with Morrie

quotes.quote: There are so many things that demand to be said. Where did you go? Do you ever think about me? You've ruined me. Are you okay? But of course, I can't say any of that.
quotes.author: Gayle Forman,  Where She Went

quotes.quote: I love her, and that's the beginning and end of everything.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald,  Dear Scott, Dearest Zelda: The Love Letters of F. Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: misgivings, n.Last night, I got up the courage to ask you if you regretted us. "There are things I miss,"you said. "But if I didn't have you, I'd miss more.
quotes.author: David Levithan,  The Lover's Dictionary

quotes.quote: Love doesn't mean anything if you're not willing to make a commitment, and you have to think not only about what you want, but about what he wants. Not just now, but in the future.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  Safe Haven

quotes.quote: Oh, love isn't there to make us happy. I believe it exists to show us how much we can endure.
quotes.author: Hermann Hesse,  Wer lieben kann, ist glÃ¼cklich. Ãœber die Liebe

quotes.quote: Like any friendship or marriage, familiarity breeds more contempt, and love, and everything.
quotes.author: Martin Freeman

quotes.quote: One does not kill oneself for love of a woman, but because love - any love - reveals us in our nakedness, our misery, our vulnerability, our nothingness.
quotes.author: Cesare Pavese

quotes.quote: i carry your heart with me(i carry it in my heart)
quotes.author: E.E. Cummings,  Selected Poems

quotes.quote: Keep love in your heart. A life without it is like a sunless garden when the flowers are dead. The consciousness of loving and being loved brings a warmth and a richness to life that nothing else can bring.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: You had to know a person well to make them laugh like that.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Prince

quotes.quote: He looked so lost, so soulful, so lonely. I wanted him to kiss me now. I wanted to let him know I was his for all eternity.
quotes.author: Ellen Schreiber,  Vampire Kisses

quotes.quote: Words can never fully say what we want them to say, for they fumble, stammer, and break the best porcelain. The best one can hope for is to find along the way someone to share the path, content to walk in silence, for the heart communes best when it does not try to speak.
quotes.author: Margaret Weis,  Dragons of a Lost Star

quotes.quote: You're supposed to say, 'All I want is your happiness. I'll do whatever it takes, even if it means being without you.'""Sorry,"Noah said. "I'm just not that big of a person.
quotes.author: Michelle Hodkin,  The Unbecoming of Mara Dyer

quotes.quote: You cannot be with someone just because you don't want to hurt him. You have your own happiness to think about.
quotes.author: Melissa de la Cruz,  The Van Alen Legacy

quotes.quote: Autumn is the hardest season. The leaves are all falling, and they're falling likethey're falling in love with the ground.
quotes.author: Andrea Gibson

quotes.quote: I live and love in God's peculiar light.
quotes.author: Michelangelo

quotes.quote: Can officially confirm that the way to a man's heart these days is not through beauty, food, sex, or alluringness of character, but merely the ability to seem not very interested in him.
quotes.author: Helen Fielding,  Bridget Jones's Diary

quotes.quote: Love is scary: it changes; it can go away. That's the part of the risk. I don't want to be scared anymore.
quotes.author: Jenny Han,  To All the Boys I've Loved Before

quotes.quote: Did you think you could stop me? I'll burn the world down to save her.
quotes.author: Jennifer L. Armentrout,  Origin

quotes.quote: Why is there ever this perverse cruelty in humankind, that makes us hurt most those we love best?
quotes.author: Jacqueline Carey,  Kushiel's Chosen

quotes.quote: Most everything you think you know about me is nothing more than memories.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  A Wild Sheep Chase
