quotes.quote: Just because I'm not forever by your side doesn't mean that's not precisely where I want to be.
quotes.author: Stephanie Laurens,  A Rogue's Proposal

quotes.quote: I seem to have run in a great circle, and met myself again on the starting line.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson,  Oranges Are Not the Only Fruit

quotes.quote: The fact is...I'm in love with you, and I have been for some time.
quotes.author: Colleen Houck,  Tiger's Curse

quotes.quote: After all, life hasn't much to offer except youth, and I suppose for older people, the love of youth in others.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: The love of truth lies at the root of much humor.
quotes.author: Robertson Davies

quotes.quote: With you, intimacy colours my voice.even 'hello' sounds like 'come here'.
quotes.author: Warsan Shire

quotes.quote: Things work out the way they're meant to
quotes.author: Danielle Steel,  No Greater Love

quotes.quote: If a man hasn't what's necessary to make a woman love him, it's his fault, not hers.
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham,  The Painted Veil

quotes.quote: The truest form of love is how you behave toward someone, not how you feel about them.
quotes.author: Steve Hall

quotes.quote: I have tried to let you go and I cannot. I cannot stop thinking of you. I cannot stop dreaming about you.
quotes.author: Erin Morgenstern,  The Night Circus

quotes.quote: Dare to love yourselfas if you were a rainbowwith gold at both ends.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

quotes.quote: If you were to ask me the best time of day to fall in love, I'd say, "Now."But you'd also have to remember to factor in the fact that my watch is eleven minutes fast.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Dying is overrated. Human sentimentality has twisted it into the ultimate act of love. Biggest load of bullshit in the world. Dying for someone isn't the hard thing. The man that dies escapes. Plain and simple. Game over. End of pain...Try living for someone. Through it all-good, bad, thick, thin, joy, suffering. That's the hard thing.
quotes.author: Karen Marie Moning,  Shadowfever

quotes.quote: Live like you were dying, Love because you are.
quotes.author: Mark Green

quotes.quote: I mix talents and friendship, which is not very professional, but it's my way of thinking. So I love Azzedine Alaia, because I've known him for 30 years, and he's making my dresses most of the time.
quotes.author: Carine Roitfeld

quotes.quote: Oh, 'tis love, 'tis love that makes the world go round.
quotes.author: Lewis Carroll

quotes.quote: Work without love is slavery.
quotes.author: Mother Teresa

quotes.quote: A man can be happy with any woman as long as he does not love her.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

quotes.quote: He is my world and my world is him and without him there is no world.
quotes.author: Lauren Oliver,  Delirium

quotes.quote: Love is a promise, love is a souvenir, once given never forgotten, never let it disappear.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: You're a hero and a gentleman, you're kind and honest, but more than that, you're the first man I ever truly loved. And no matter what the future brings, you always will be, and I know that my life is better for it.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  Dear John

quotes.quote: Transformation is my favorite game and in my experience, anger and frustration are the result of you not being authentic somewhere in your life or with someone in your life. Being fake about anything creates a block inside of you. Life can't work for you if you don't show up as you.
quotes.author: Jason Mraz

quotes.quote: You must give everything to make your life as beautiful as the dreams that dance in your imagination.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: Mocking a woman is like drinking too much wine. It may be fun for a short time, but the hangover is hell.
quotes.author: Brandon Sanderson,  Warbreaker

quotes.quote: Now I'd rather be infected with love for the tiniest sliver of a second than live a hundred years smothered by a lie.
quotes.author: Lauren Oliver,  Delirium

quotes.quote: You made me feel alive again.
quotes.author: Julie Kagawa,  The Iron King

quotes.quote: I don't care if you danced naked on the roof of the Little Palace with him. I love you, Alina, even the part of you that loved him.
quotes.author: Leigh Bardugo,  Shadow and Bone

quotes.quote: If you're smart, you care. And if you care, you love.
quotes.author: Lauren Oliver,  Pandemonium

quotes.quote: If you have it [love], you don't need to have anything else, and if you don't have it, it doesn't matter much what else you have.
quotes.author: J.M. Barrie

quotes.quote: What should I do about the wild and the tame? The wild heart that wants to be free, and the tame heart that wants to come home. I want to be held. I don't want you to come too close. I want you to scoop me up and bring me home at nights. I don't want to tell you where I am. I want to keep a place among the rocks where no one can find me. I want to be with you.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson

quotes.quote: And I can fight only for something that I love, love only what I respect, and respect only what I at least know.
quotes.author: Adolf Hitler

quotes.quote: Only time can heal your broken heart. Just as only time can heal his broken arms and legs.
quotes.author: Jim Henson

quotes.quote: One more secret smile. One more shared laugh. One more electric kiss. Finding him was like finding someone I didn't know I was searching for.
quotes.author: Becca Fitzpatrick,  Hush, Hush

quotes.quote: Love is like whoa! Actually, it's closer to woe.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

quotes.quote: The minute I stopped trying to find the right girl, and started trying to become the right guy...the girl came.
quotes.author: Jonathan Antin

quotes.quote: You were you,and I was I;we were twobefore our time.I was yoursbefore I knew,and you have always been mine too.
quotes.author: Lang Leav,  Love & Misadventure

quotes.quote: The dawn is not distant, nor is the night starless; love is eternal.
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.quote: I don't care if you say we can't be together. I don't care if you think I'm the most evil, unnatural creature walking on earth. You can think whatever you want, go whatever you want. I'm going to just go on loving you, even if it's hopeless.
quotes.author: Richelle Mead,  The Indigo Spell

quotes.quote: Love is the strongest force the world possesses and yet it is the humblest imaginable.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: I get in that kind of situation all the time, Comrade. It's not a big deal."Anger replaced my fear. I didn't like being treated like a child. "Stop calling me that. You don't even know what you're talking about.""Sure I do. I had to do a report on the R.S.S.R. last year.
quotes.author: Richelle Mead,  Vampire Academy

quotes.quote: If two people love each other there can be no happy end to it.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: Love, when spelled backwards and read phonetically, reads evil
quotes.author: Eminem

quotes.quote: I wish you could be kissed, Jane,' he said. 'Because I would beg just one off you. Under all this.' He flailed an arm toward the stars.
quotes.author: Maggie Stiefvater,  The Dream Thieves

quotes.quote: I don't want to live, I want to love first and live incidentally.
quotes.author: Zelda Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: Love like rain, can nourish from above, drenching couples with soaking joy. But sometimes, under the angry heat of life, love dries on the surface and must nourish from below, tending to its roots, keeping itself alive.
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  The Five People You Meet in Heaven

quotes.quote: Make me into anything, but just love me.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Invisible Monsters

quotes.quote: A busy, vibrant, goal-oriented woman is so much more attractive than a woman who waits around for a man to validate her existence.
quotes.author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

quotes.quote: It is a defect of God's humor that he directs our hearts everywhere but to those who have a right to them.
quotes.author: Tom Stoppard,  Arcadia

quotes.quote: Through my love for you, I want to express my love for the whole cosmos, the whole of humanity, and all beings. By living with you, I want to learn to love everyone and all species. If I succeed in loving you, I will be able to love everyone and all species on Earth... This is the real message of love.
quotes.author: Hanh Nhat Thich,  Teachings on Love

quotes.quote: After all, damn it, what does being in love mean if you can't trust a person.
quotes.author: Evelyn Waugh,  Vile Bodies

quotes.quote: When is a monster not a monster? Oh, when you love it.
quotes.author: Caitlyn Siehl,  Literary Sexts: A Collection of Short & Sexy Love Poems

quotes.quote: The more we love our friends, the less we flatter them; it is by excusing nothing that pure love shows itself.
quotes.author: Moliere

quotes.quote: Love is a trap. When it appears, we see only its light, not its shadows.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  By the River Piedra I Sat Down and Wept

quotes.quote: And now,"Eric yelled into his mircophone, "we're going to sing a new song-one we just wrote. This one's for my girlfriend. We've been going out for three weeks, and, damn, our love is true. We're gonna be together forever, baby. This one's called 'Bang You Like a Drum.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Fallen Angels

quotes.quote: I go to sleep alone, and wake up alone. I take walks. I work until I'm tired. I watch the wind play with the trash that's been under the snow all winter. Everything seems simple until you think about it. Why is love intensified by abscence?
quotes.author: Audrey Niffenegger,  The Time Traveler's Wife

quotes.quote: How could you go about choosing something that would hold the half of your heart you had to bury?
quotes.author: Jodi Picoult,  Mercy

quotes.quote: How do you know when it's over?""Maybe when you feel more in love with your memories than with the person standing in front of you.
quotes.author: Gunnar Ardelius,  I Need You More Than I Love You and I Love You to Bits

quotes.quote: Because you are the superhero fledgling. I'm just your more attractive sidekick. Oh, and the herd of nerds are your dorky minions.
quotes.author: P.C. Cast,  Untamed

quotes.quote: Love one another, but make not a bond of love:Let it rather be a moving sea between the shores of your souls.
quotes.author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

quotes.quote: I am the most miserable person who ever lived,"he said... "You are young, and in love,"said Primus. "Every young man in your position is the most miserable young man who ever lived.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  Stardust

quotes.quote: To be rejected by someone doesn't mean you should also reject yourself or that you should think of yourself as a lesser person. It doesn't mean that nobody will ever love you anymore. Remember that only ONE person has rejected you at the moment, and it only hurt so much because to you, that person's opinion symbolized the opinion of the whole world, of God.
quotes.author: Jocelyn Soriano,  Mend My Broken Heart

quotes.quote: Love consists of not looking each other in the eye, but of looking outwardly in the same direction.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-ExupÃ©ry,  Airman's Odyssey

quotes.quote: Every friendship travels at sometime through the black valley of despair. This tests every aspect of your affection. You lose the attraction and the magic. Your sense of each other darkens and your presence is sore. If you can come through this time, it can purify with your love, and falsity and need will fall away. It will bring you onto new ground where affection can grow again.
quotes.author: John O'Donohue,  Anam Cara: A Book of Celtic Wisdom

quotes.quote: Do you know what hurts so very much? It's love. Love is the strongest force in the world, and when it is blocked that means pain. There are two things we can do when this happens. We can kill that love so that it stops hurting. But then of course part of us dies, too. Or we can ask God to open up another route for that love to travel.
quotes.author: Corrie ten Boom,  The Hiding Place

quotes.quote: Surely it was a good way to die, in the place of someone else, someone I loved.
quotes.author: Stephenie Meyer,  Twilight

quotes.quote: It's only terrible to have nothing to wait for.
quotes.author: Erich Maria Remarque,  Three Comrades

quotes.quote: Love takes off masks that we fear we cannot live without and know we cannot live within.
quotes.author: James A. Baldwin

quotes.quote: Don't go looking for boys in the darkThey will say pretty things thenleave you with scars.Do go looking for boys in the parkFor that is where the true gentlemen are.
quotes.author: Anna Godbersen,  The Luxe

quotes.quote: Oh, Lizzy! do anything rather than marry without affection.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

quotes.quote: I loved you so much once. I did. More than anything in the whole wide world. Imagine that. What a laugh that is now. Can you believe it? We were so intimate once upon a time I can't believe it now. The memory of being that intimate with somebody. We were so intimate I could puke. I can't imagine ever being that intimate with somebody else. I haven't been.
quotes.author: Raymond Carver,  Where I'm Calling From: New and Selected Stories

quotes.quote: Love is where you find it. I think it is foolish to go around looking for it, and I think it can be poisonous. I wish that people who are conventionally supposed to love each other would say to each other, when they fight, 'Please -- a little less love, and a little more common decency'.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Slapstick or Lonesome No More!

quotes.quote: He was my North, my South, my East and West,My working week and my Sunday rest,My noon, my midnight, my talk, my song;I thought that love would last forever: I was wrong.
quotes.author: W.H. Auden,  Collected Poems

quotes.quote: I require three things in a man: he must be handsome, ruthless, and stupid.
quotes.author: Dorothy Parker

quotes.quote: Often it is the most deserving people who cannot help loving those who destroy them.
quotes.author: Hermann Hesse

quotes.quote: All of sudden, this shooting star went by, and all I could think was that they were listening to us somehow.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks

quotes.quote: I want you to be weak. As weak as I am.
quotes.author: Milan Kundera,  The Unbearable Lightness of Being

quotes.quote: If your heart is a volcano, how shall you expect flowers to bloom?
quotes.author: Khalil Gibran

quotes.quote: The only gift I have to give, is the ability to receive. If giving is a gift, and it surely is, then my gift to you is to allow you to give to me.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  The Titanic would never have sunk if it were made out of a sink.

quotes.quote: Don't worry about hurting me, if that's what you're afraid of. I want to get hurt. At least IÂ´ll feel something for a change.
quotes.author: Katie Kacvinsky,  Awaken

quotes.quote: If I were a tree, I would have no reason to love a human.
quotes.author: Maggie Stiefvater,  The Raven Boys

quotes.quote: I'm willing to die for the woman I love. I just want to take 75 years to do it.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Who Moved My Choose?: An Amazing Way to Deal With Change by Deciding to Let Indecision Into Your Life

quotes.quote: If love had feathers and tasted like dog food, then I suggest you wear shoes with your banana pudding. (This statement also defines my political beliefs).
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: The best relationships in our lives are the best not because they have been the happiest ones, they are that way because they have stayed strong through the most tormentful of storms.
quotes.author: Pandora Poikilos,  Excuse Me, My Brains Have Stepped Out

quotes.quote: She is all the great heroines of the world in one. She is more than an individual. I love her, and I must make her love me. I want to make Romeo jealous. I want the dead lovers of the world to hear our laughter, and grow sad. I want a breath of our passion to stir dust into consciousness, to wake their ashes into pain.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

Also remember, sisters make the best friends in the world. As for lovers, well, they'll come and go too. And baby, I hate to say it, most of them - actually pretty much all of them are going to break your heart, but you can't give up because if you give up, you'll never find your soulmate. Keep trying, hold on, and always, always, always believe in yourself, because if you don't, then who will, sweetie? quotes.quote: 'You may not be her first, her last, or her only. She loved before she may love again. But if she loves you now, what else matters? She may not be thinking about you every second of the day, but she will give you a part of her that she knows you can break--her heart. So don't hurt her, don't change her, don't analyze and don't expect more than she can give. Smile when she makes you happy, let her know when she makes you mad, and miss her when she's not there.'
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: 'The opposite of love is not hate, it's indifference. The opposite of art is not ugliness, it's indifference. The opposite of faith is not heresy, it's indifference. And the opposite of life is not death, it's indifference.'
quotes.author: Elie Wiesel

quotes.quote: 'I love you without knowing how, or when, or from where. I love you simply, without problems or pride: I love you in this way because I do not know any other way of loving but this, in which there is no I or you, so intimate that your hand upon my chest is my hand, so intimate that when I fall asleep your eyes close.'
quotes.author: Pablo Neruda

quotes.quote: 'The real lover is the man who can thrill you by kissing your forehead or smiling into your eyes or just staring into space.'
quotes.author: Marilyn Monroe

quotes.quote: 'To love at all is to be vulnerable. Love anything and your heart will be wrung and possibly broken. If you want to make sure of keeping it intact you must give it to no one, not even an animal. Wrap it carefully round with hobbies and little luxuries; avoid all entanglements. Lock it up safe in the casket or coffin of your selfishness. But in that casket, safe, dark, motionless, airless, it will change. It will not be broken; it will become unbreakable, impenetrable, irredeemable. To love is to be vulnerable.'
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis
